target_audience: University students with basic calculus/linear algebra knowledge

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Weights and the Guess
lecture_lines: A neuron takes inputs through weighted connections.
We compute the weighted sum plus a bias.
Compare the predicted output with the target.
The difference between these is our Error.
[Asset: neuron_diagram] shows the weighted signal flow.

sections.title: The Error Surface Visualization
lecture_lines: Visualize the Cost Function as a landscape.
Low points represent minimal error predictions.
The algorithm acts like a hiker.
It descends towards the lowest valley.
[Asset: error_surface] displays the error landscape.
animations: Draw 3D landscape of the loss surface. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Intuitive Backpropagation (The Credit Assignment)
lecture_lines: Backpropagation is simply the Chain Rule.
Distribute the Error backward across weights.
Calculate each weight's contribution to error.
Identify which connection requires adjustment.
[Asset: network_propagation] shows error flowing backwards.

sections.title: The Feedback Loop: Updating Weights
lecture_lines: Combine the gradient with learning rate.
Nudge each weight closer to ideal.
Iteratively refine until error is minimized.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Forward pass computes the initial prediction.
Backward pass identifies the needed changes.
Weights update to improve future guesses.
